title: ICT Risk and Operational Resilience
summary: Building and evidencing ICT risk management and operational resilience for the hybrid on-chain and off-chain architecture of crypto-asset firms, including cloud concentration and complex outsourcing chains.
contentGaps: Written as part of a programme: Aim and Purpose is the module's one-line description; audience, prior knowledge and core reading come from the programme

sections.Aim and Purpose: Building and evidencing ICT risk management and operational resilience for the hybrid on-chain and off-chain architecture of crypto-asset firms, including cloud concentration and complex outsourcing chains.
Learning Objectives: Identify ICT and operational risks specific to crypto-asset operations
Design ICT risk management, incident reporting and resilience testing
Manage third-party and cloud dependencies with credible exit arrangements
Syllabus: Key infrastructure, API dependencies and smart contract upgrade risk
ICT incident classification, reporting and internal escalation
Business continuity, penetration testing and scenario exercises
Third-party ICT contracts, concentration and exit planning
Intended Audience: Heads of compliance, compliance officers and compliance monitoring staff at crypto-asset service providers and issuers
Risk managers, MLROs, financial crime and internal audit professionals covering crypto-asset activities
Senior managers and legal staff responsible for authorisation, regulatory engagement and remediation
sections.Useful Prior Knowledge and Experience: Working knowledge of crypto-assets and of compliance or risk in a regulated firm is helpful; the Crypto and Blockchain Fundamentals for Firms programme provides a suitable foundation.
Core Reading: IOSCO, Policy Recommendations for Crypto and Digital Asset Markets (2023)
IOSCO, Policy Recommendations for Decentralized Finance (2023)
FATF, Updated Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach to Virtual Assets and Virtual Asset Service Providers (2021)
FSB, High-level Recommendations for the Regulation, Supervision and Oversight of Global Stablecoin Arrangements (2023)
